site.tagline: Applied AI for manufacturing, finance, retail and education
site.description: We take one concrete operational problem — counting output on a line, pulling data off paperwork, forecasting stock — and hand back a system running inside the infrastructure you already have.

hero.title: Get AI into <hl>the systems you already run</hl>

statement.title: Sharp talent. Real systems. Measurable impact.
statement.body: We don’t hand over prototypes—we deliver AI that runs in production. Our engineers cut time to value, harden what matters, and keep quality visible after go-live.

stats.label: ANZ in numbers
stats.title: We're ready. Are you?
stats.body: ANZ provides scalable talent to deliver solutions that move your business forward.

features.title: The problems we take on
features.description: Six operational problems across manufacturing, finance, retail and logistics, and education. We go deep on a few rather than taking on everything.

vision.title: Computer vision
vision.description: Count output, catch defects and flag safety breaches from the feeds you already have. No hardware swap — the model runs on an edge box on site or on your own server.

education.title: Education
education.description: Written feedback on open answers, learning paths that follow each learner's gaps, progress reports for teachers. Our AI Mentor product is built along these lines.

conversational.title: Language & assistants
conversational.description: Staff ask in plain Vietnamese and get an answer citing the exact page of the procedure, contract or manual. When it cannot find a source it declines rather than guesses.

generative.title: Generative AI
generative.description: Draft reports, summarise minutes, pull knowledge out of an internal document store. If the data may not leave your infrastructure, we deploy inside your network.

document.title: Document intelligence
document.description: Turn paper into structured records that go straight into your ERP or accounting software. Fields the model is unsure of go to a review queue instead of being filled in blind.

predictive.title: Analytics & forecasting
predictive.description: Stock and order forecasting for retail and logistics, anomaly detection for finance. Built on the history you already hold, not on a new data collection project.

howItWorks.title: From the problem to a system in production
howItWorks.description: You see the numbers before you commit a large budget.

discovery.title: Agree the number before any code is written
discovery.description: We ask what you measure today and which figure has to move. If the data you hold cannot get to that figure, you hear it at this step rather than after the contract is signed.

pilot.title: Prove it on a narrow scope
pilot.description: One line, one document type, one branch. The pilot is measured on the figure we agreed, against your real data rather than a clean sample set.

rollout.title: Integrate, then stay on
rollout.description: Wire into the ERP, camera network or data store you already run; watch model quality after handover and retrain when the data shifts.

team.title: Our people
team.description: The engineers who scope the problem are the ones who ship it — and pick up the phone when it breaks.
